completion_gate: Exactly five distinct complete idea bodies plus a recommended first non-executed test and per-idea internal-overlap explanation.
Source list carries honest provenance and source read scope; no novelty, result, or approval claim beyond this task.
No executable attack procedure, experiment execution, or shared-ledger write.
constraints: Proposal-only defensive mathematical intake; no experiments, cryptographic solver implementation, operational key-recovery procedure, live targets, or offensive workflow.
Preserve every existing record and unrelated work. Write only new declared paths in the isolated intake worktree.
No hypothesis, question, or goal status transition; no claim promotion, closure, or declaration of a cryptanalytic improvement.
No Bedrock provider, backend, endpoint, model, fallback, or probe.
Administrative checks and source inspection are not mathematical validation. Do not fabricate observations, attestations, model identities, or command receipts.
Use exactly the five IDEA identifiers reserved in intake-plan.json; output ideas.json as an object with an ideas list of exactly five complete canonical idea bodies.
New records remain status proposed with approved_by null and novelty_status unverified; distinguish retrieved source claims from untested internal proposals.

Apply the exemplar search heuristics in agents/idea-generator.md and docs/target-result-profile.md; the purpose here is to identify decision-changing prerequisite questions, with zero claimed algorithmic speedup.

Read the nearest internal proposal bodies and the source-context note. For each candidate, give a concrete discriminated_from delta; do not rename orbit rank control, invariant-coordinate degree comparisons, generic table reduction, or already-published invariant factor bases.

Each idea needs all mandatory schema fields, class, mechanism, quantitative falsifiable predictions, minimal non-offensive mathematical/control test, controls, confounders, failure conditions, required artifacts and interpretation limits.

Include heuristic_assumptions and target_complexity even for a control or measurement; use an empty heuristic list with an explicit reason when no distribution assumption is made. No cryptographic-scale validation route may be invented.
If proof-oriented, supply every proof_search_map audit and obligation before recommending any later design. A minimal test description is a proposal, never approval to run.

Check and cite the actual applicable frontier entries. Keep dominated_by as explicit non-null text if full dominance is unresolved. sota_delta must quantify the diagnostic deliverable and explicitly record zero demonstrated algorithmic gain; do not claim Pareto superiority.

Treat every existing proposal as a proposal unless its cited evidence is read and verified; no legacy negative or closure assertion is adopted as fact. H-STR-002 and DEFER-BATCH009-001 remain unchanged.

Record exactly which sources you actually read and actual native session provenance, separately from API probe verification. Do not copy parent model provenance as your own unless independently present in your session.
Return incomplete records as incomplete; do not fabricate five successful mechanisms to hit the count.
